description.narrative:
In line with the 2030 Strategy, the Global Ocean Observing System (GOOS), coordinated by IOC, has three strategic goals:
1. Deepening Engagement and Impact 2. System Integration and Delivery 3. Building for the Future
The aim is to provide authoritative guidance on integrated observing system design, synthesize across evolving requirements and identify gaps; enable sustaining, strengthening and expanding observing system implementation through GOOS and partner communities; promote standards and best practice; develop metrics to measure success; ensure GOOS ocean observing data and information are findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable, with appropriate quality and latency; and support innovation in observing technologies and networks.
